discovery: "OOH! Those two TOGETHER?! Ears AND eyes?! The audience did NOT see that coming! Nothing hides from you now! NOTHING!"
flavor: Your ears and eyes agree. Nothing hides.
name: Apex Sense

discovery_method.hint: Echo first. Then hunt. Let your ears guide your eyes.
discovery_method.tease1: For a heartbeat, the world had edges made of sound. Then it was just... quiet. Did you imagine that?
discovery_method.tease2: The echo came back wrong — no, not wrong. *More.* You could hear the shape of something moving, almost see it. Then it slipped away. So close.

discovery: "WAIT. You grow the food AND you eat the sun?! That's... that's double-dipping! The gamblers are FURIOUS they didn't think of it! The plants like you AND you ARE a plant?!"
flavor: The plants feed you. You feed the plants. The System is confused and delighted.
name: Sun Eater's Garden

discovery_method.hint: Tend living things in the daylight, day after day. Be patient. Be a garden.
discovery_method.tease1: Your hands tingled in the sun today. The plants seemed to lean toward you. Probably the wind.
discovery_method.tease2: The garden *hummed*. You felt it in your teeth — green and gold and hungry. Then it stopped. It wants... something. Repetition?

discovery: "Nothing wasted?! EVERYTHING returns?! Oh, the efficiency! The AUDIENCE is taking notes! This is the most sustainable contestant we've EVER had!"
flavor: Nothing wasted. Everything returns.
name: Closed Loop

discovery_method.hint: Cook, then return the scraps to the earth. Nothing wasted.
discovery_method.tease1: The buried scraps seemed warmer than they should be. The soil... appreciated it? That's a strange thought.
discovery_method.tease2: Where you buried yesterday's meal, something is already sprouting. Too fast. Impossibly fast. Then it slowed, as if embarrassed to be seen.

discovery: "You could talk a HUSHWOLF out of dinner! The drama division is filing a complaint — you're ruining their storylines! KEEP GOING!"
flavor: You speak and rooms settle.
name: Peacemaker's Voice

discovery_method.hint: Talk first. Then mend. Words open the door; understanding walks through.
discovery_method.tease1: Mid-conversation, the air went still. Everyone was listening — really listening — for just a moment. Then someone coughed.
discovery_method.tease2: You watched two people who hate each other *almost* understand each other. The words were right there, on the edge of your tongue. Then the moment passed.

discovery: "Blood IN! Blood OUT! It's a CIRCUIT! Oh that's DARK! The audience is covering their eyes but PEEKING! We love it! We shouldn't! We DO!"
flavor: Blood in, blood out. The circuit closes. (Blood Price costs 3 less HP.)
name: Crimson Circuit

discovery_method.hint: Spend blood. Then drink it back. Close the circuit.
discovery_method.tease1: The blood you spent seemed to hesitate before leaving you. Like it wanted to come back.
discovery_method.tease2: You felt it — a loop, almost closed. Power leaving and returning in the same breath. Your veins buzzed. Then the circuit broke, and you were just... tired.

discovery: "It REFUSES to fall! It REFUSES to calm down! ANGER plus UNDEATH?! The sponsors just tripled the odds! FIGHT! FIGHT! FIGHT!"
flavor: When Second Wind triggers during rage, you return at FULL health and the rage does not end.
name: Undying Fury

discovery_method.hint: Refuse to fall while refusing to calm down.
discovery_method.tease1: Death reached for you and your anger *slapped its hand away*. For a second. Then you fell anyway.
discovery_method.tease2: You died angry — and for one impossible moment, the anger held you up. You were standing. Dead, but standing. Then the rage broke, and so did you.

discovery: "You don't FIND water! Water FINDS YOU! The weather team wants to know your SECRET! There IS no secret! That's the best part!"
flavor: You don't find water. Water finds you.
name: Rain Catcher

discovery_method.hint: Seek water when the sky is already giving it.
discovery_method.tease1: The dowsing stick twitched toward the clouds. That's... not how it's supposed to work.
discovery_method.tease2: Rain bent toward your outstretched hand. Just a little. Just enough to notice. The clouds seemed surprised too.

discovery: "Shed! Harden! Shed! Harden! It's BEAUTIFUL! Like watching armor decide to be ALIVE! The audience is molting EMOTIONALLY!"
flavor: Shed and harden. Shed and harden. (+25 max HP.)
name: Perfect Chrysalis

discovery_method.hint: Shed, then harden. Shed, then harden. Let the cycle turn.
discovery_method.tease1: Your skin itched in a way that felt... purposeful. Like it was rehearsing something.
discovery_method.tease2: After the blow, your skin rippled — almost shed, almost renewed, then settled. It knows what it wants to do. It just needs... practice.

discovery: "You SEE it, don't you?! The SEAMS! The world has SEAMS and you're READING them! Our technicians are NERVOUS! Keep looking! Don't look at US!"
flavor: The world has seams. You see them.
name: Sees the Weave

discovery_method.hint: Look for patterns, day after day. The seams will show.
discovery_method.tease1: For a second, the world had a texture — like fabric, like something woven. You blinked and it was just trees again.
discovery_method.tease2: You saw it. A seam. A place where the world was stitched together slightly wrong. You reached for it and it... wasn't there. But you *saw* it.

discovery: "The living AND the dead?! You're looting BOTH SIDES of mortality! The ancestors' union has filed a grievance! We tore it up! DELVE! DELVE!"
flavor: The dead don't mind. Much.
name: Delver

discovery_method.hint: Rob the living and the dead in the same place.
discovery_method.tease1: The ruins felt... cooperative today. Like they wanted to be searched.
discovery_method.tease2: You found something in the rubble that shouldn't have been there — something old that *noticed* you finding it. Then it was just an old coin. Probably.

discovery: "Less fuel! SAME distance! You're... you're OPTIMIZED! Our engineers are taking notes and feeling INADEQUATE! Walk, efficient one! WALK!"
flavor: Less fuel. Same distance. The System takes notes.
name: Efficient Machine

discovery_method.hint: Walk far, walk light, walk cold. Efficiency is a practice.
discovery_method.tease1: The walk felt easier today. Less fuel, same distance. Your body is learning something.
discovery_method.tease2: You stopped to rest and realized you didn't need to. Your breath was slow, your steps were light, and the miles just... happened. Then you thought about it, and the feeling faded.

discovery: "It DIED! It's BACK! It DIED! It's BACK! Death keeps filing the paperwork and you keep LOSING it! The underworld wants a recount! DENIED!"
flavor: Your death cheats recharge twice as fast. Death is getting annoyed.
name: Refuses Death

discovery_method.hint: Die. Return. Die again. Return again. Death keeps score; you keep erasing it.
discovery_method.tease1: Death filed the paperwork. You lost it. Death is getting annoyed.
discovery_method.tease2: You came back *again*, and for a moment death itself seemed to hesitate — like it was checking its notes, confused. Then it remembered its job.

name: Field Pharmacy
flavor: Grow the cure. Apply the cure. Repeat.
discovery: "You GROW the medicine AND you USE the medicine?! Vertical integration! The sponsors want to franchise you! One location! MANY wounds! DOCTOR! DOCTOR!"

discovery_method.hint: Gather the right plants, then treat the wound. The order matters.
discovery_method.tease1: The poultice felt... correct today. The herbs wanted to be exactly where you put them.
discovery_method.tease2: Your hands reached for the bandage before your brain finished the diagnosis. They already knew. Two more treatments and they'll know it by heart.

name: Surgeon's Calm
flavor: Assess first. Shake never.
discovery: "You LOOK at the wound AND your hands DON'T SHAKE?! The drama division just lost its best cliffhanger! Boring! MAGNIFICENT! BORING!"

discovery_method.hint: Size up the wound first, then work it slow and steady.
discovery_method.tease1: You caught yourself pausing before touching the wound. Actually LOOKING at it first. Since when do you do that?
discovery_method.tease2: Your hands were steady. Eerily steady. The bleeding stopped cooperating with panic. One more calm treatment and this becomes a habit.

name: Critter Network
flavor: Every small thing owes you a favor.
discovery: "The BIRDS talk to you AND the SQUIRRELS talk to you?! A whole INTELLIGENCE AGENCY of small mammals! The squirrels deny everything! WE HAVE FOOTAGE!"

discovery_method.hint: Befriend the small things, day after day. Listen more than you speak.
discovery_method.tease1: A jay followed you all morning, scolding. It felt like a briefing.
discovery_method.tease2: The squirrel left something on your pack. A maple key. Arranged. Deliberately. It was a message. You almost understood it.

name: Cornered Fury
flavor: Backs to walls hit harder. Violence stays desperate, never clean.
discovery: "You let them SURROUND you ON PURPOSE?! That's not a plan! That's a LIFESTYLE! The safety counselors are concerned! The audience is THRILLED!"

discovery_method.hint: Let them surround you. Then stop holding back.
discovery_method.tease1: Outnumbered, your hands stopped shaking. That was new. And a little frightening.
discovery_method.tease2: Cornered in the last fight, you felt the fear turn. Not away, but INTO something. Into aim. One more corner and it won't turn back.

name: Clean Plate
flavor: Clean what you can. Stomach the rest.
discovery: "You CLEAN the food AND your gut forgives EVERYTHING?! The food-safety division is OUTRAGED! The gamblers ate a questionable mushroom in your honor! It's FINE! Probably!"

discovery_method.hint: Clean your food carefully, day after day. Trust your gut. Literally.
discovery_method.tease1: The water tasted wrong today and your stomach just... handled it. Rude of it. Helpful, though.
discovery_method.tease2: You ate the thing nobody else would touch. It was fine. Your gut gurgled in a way that sounded almost smug. It's learning your habits.

name: Polyglot's Ledger
flavor: Every language is a door. You carry the keys.
discovery: "You READ their stories AND you SPEAK their tongue?! The subtitling department is OUT OF A JOB! We had to give them hats! KEEP TALKING!"

discovery_method.hint: Read their world. Listen to their words. Day after day.
discovery_method.tease1: A word in their tongue came to you uninvited today. It just arrived, wearing a little hat of context.
discovery_method.tease2: You dreamed in two languages and understood both. The journal pages are starting to annotate themselves. Almost.

name: Tidecaller
flavor: The fisher's tide-reading + your hands + the water's gift. You don't fish. You ask.
discovery: "WAIT. You read the tide AND you breathe water?! The fish just... come to you?! That's not fishing, that's a CONVERSATION!"

discovery_method.hint: Breathe the water. Then fish. Let the tide teach you.
discovery_method.tease1: Underwater, you felt the current shift — and somehow knew fish were coming. The tide-reading technique itched at the back of your mind.
discovery_method.tease2: You read the water like the fishers taught you, and your lungs didn't burn. The fish came. They just... came.

name: Seedkeeper's Promise
flavor: The farmer's seed wisdom + your hands + the green gift. What you plant remembers you.
discovery: "You save the seeds AND you grow them with your HANDS?! The plants are writing you into their family tree! LITERALLY!"

discovery_method.hint: Grow with the gift. Then save the seeds. The cycle teaches.
discovery_method.tease1: The seeds you saved felt warm. Not from the sun — from something else. Your green thumb tingled.
discovery_method.tease2: You planted a saved seed and it sprouted overnight. The farmer's technique + your gift — the earth noticed.

name: Wildreader
flavor: The forager's tracking + your eye + the hunter's gift. The wild leaves you letters.
discovery: "You track plants LIKE animals?! With the hunter's eyes?! The forest is just... TELLING you where everything is!"

discovery_method.hint: Track like a hunter. Then forage. The signs are the same.
discovery_method.tease1: You saw a broken twig and knew — not an animal, a plant. The forager's teaching surfaced unbidden.
discovery_method.tease2: Tracker eyes + plant knowledge. You followed the signs to a patch of exactly what you needed. The wild provides.

name: Ringcraft
flavor: Fight where they can see you. The crowd is a weapon too.
discovery: "OHHH! You fight DIRTY and you look GOOD doing it! The audience is taking notes AND taking cover! FIGHT WHERE THEY CAN SEE YOU!"

discovery_method.hint: Brawl first. Then let them watch you do it again.
discovery_method.tease1: After the fight, you caught three villagers staring. Not at the bruises — at you. Like you'd become weather.
discovery_method.tease2: You threw a punch the whole clearing could see coming, and it landed anyway. Somewhere behind you, someone gasped. You liked that.

name: Trade of Blows
flavor: Trade damage like currency. You can afford the exchange rate.
discovery: "You TAKE the hit to LAND the hit?! That's not strategy! That's... okay that's actually strategy! The medics are FURIOUS! KEEP TRADING!"

discovery_method.hint: Get hit. Hit back. Refuse the difference.
discovery_method.tease1: You took a blow you could have dodged, and the counter landed twice as hard. Your ribs filed a complaint. Your fists overruled it.
discovery_method.tease2: Hurt and swinging, you felt the second wind coming early — like your body had decided the bill was already paid. One more trade and it won't ask permission.

name: Rooms Go Quiet
flavor: Don't raise your voice. Lower the room's.
discovery: "You didn't even MOVE! The whole ROOM just... deflated! Our fear sensors need recalibrating! Say LESS! MEAN MORE!"

discovery_method.hint: Stand still. Let the quiet do the work.
discovery_method.tease1: You stopped mid-sentence and the argument died with it. Nobody told it to. It just... lay down.
discovery_method.tease2: Someone started shouting and you just looked at them. The shouting ran out of air. You hadn't even decided to be scary yet.

description: Your presence silences rooms. People obey out of fear, not loyalty. Disputes resolve quickly — nobody wants to be noticed.

name: Borrowed Surge
flavor: Hold the surge. Spend it on the one hit that matters.
discovery: "You SAVED it?! You banked the adrenaline like POCKET MONEY and spent it ALL on one punch! The economists are taking notes! SPEND BIG!"

discovery_method.hint: Steady the surge first. Then throw it all into one strike.
discovery_method.tease1: Mid-fight you felt the rush rise and — instead of riding it — you held it. Coiled it. Your hands were shaking with the weight of it.
discovery_method.tease2: You let the adrenaline pool behind your eyes and spent it on a single uppercut. The surge was gone in a heartbeat. So was the other guy's balance.

name: Everybody's Friend
flavor: Talk pretty. Then listen harder.
discovery: "You talk to EVERYONE and everyone talks to YOU?! You're not networking, you're COLLECTING people! The census bureau is jealous! KEEP COLLECTING!"

discovery_method.hint: Charm them first. Then hear what the charm loosened.
discovery_method.tease1: You complimented Mara's stew and by dessert you knew who'd been stealing firewood. Nobody meant to tell you. They just... did.
discovery_method.tease2: Your silver tongue opened the door; your listening walked through it. Three conversations in one evening, and every one of them handed you something they hadn't meant to.

name: Word of Mouth
flavor: Hear everything. Mend everything.
discovery: "You know EVERYTHING and you FIX everything?! The village hotline has been REPLACED! By YOU! In ONE person! ANSWER THE CALLS!"

discovery_method.hint: Learn the grudge first. Then walk into the middle of it.
discovery_method.tease1: You knew about the fence dispute two days before it boiled over — you'd heard both sides at the well. When it blew up, you were already standing between them.
discovery_method.tease2: The gossip told you exactly where it would break. You arrived with the words ready. Peace, it turns out, is mostly showing up informed.

name: Talked Down
flavor: Talk them down before it starts.
discovery: "A FIGHT was starting and you just... TALKED it out of existing?! The security team is OUT of a job! The audience is STILL cheering! TALK FASTER!"

discovery_method.hint: Speak while tempers are still deciding.
discovery_method.tease1: Two hunters squared up over a snare line and you were talking before either of them had finished turning around. By the time they faced each other, the fight had nowhere to go.
discovery_method.tease2: You felt a brawl gathering like weather and started talking — low, quick, reasonable. The storm broke around you and never landed.

name: Story Sold
flavor: The harvest sells itself when you tell its story.
discovery: "You sold TURNIPS with a SPEECH?! People are trading spare boots for your STORY about turnips! The turnips are INCIDENTAL! SELL THE STORY!"

discovery_method.hint: Work the field. Then work the room.
discovery_method.tease1: You told the traders about the blight you beat and the rain you prayed for, and they paid double for the grain. The grain was fine. The story was better.
discovery_method.tease2: Silver tongue in the field, silver tongue at the table. Your harvest moves because people want a piece of the telling, not just the eating.

name: Trailblazer's Promise
flavor: The village cuts the trail. You read where it's going.
discovery: "The village BLAZES it and you just... KNOW it?! You walk their fresh-cut trails like you've walked them for YEARS! The trail crew wants a RAISE! WALK IT!"

discovery_method.hint: Find the way. Then walk the village's cut.
discovery_method.tease1: You followed a freshly blazed trail and never once checked for markers — your feet just knew the turns. The blazers' work and your instinct shook hands.
discovery_method.tease2: Trail-blazing technique under your boots, pathfinder sense in your head. The miles cost you half what they cost everyone else. You barely noticed the distance.

name: Farsight
flavor: See far. Then go there.
discovery: "You SAW it from THREE ridges away and then just... WALKED to it?! The scouts are filing a UNION complaint! LOOK FARTHER!"

discovery_method.hint: Spot it first. Then close the distance.
discovery_method.tease1: From the ridge you picked out a berry thicket two valleys over — a smudge of red nobody else could see. Your feet were already moving.
discovery_method.tease2: Eagle eyes found the herd; pathfinder legs ate the miles between. By the time anyone asked where you were going, you were already there.

name: Owl Hours
flavor: Day eyes. Night eyes. No shift is blind.
discovery: "You see in the DARK?! Like, ACTUALLY see?! The night crew just lost their excuse for everything! NO SHIFT IS SAFE FROM YOU!"

discovery_method.hint: Watch by day, watch by night. Let both shifts teach.
discovery_method.tease1: At dusk your sharp eyes didn't fade — they changed. Shapes kept their edges long after the light gave up.
discovery_method.tease2: You hunted at noon and at midnight in the same week, and neither darkness nor distance hid anything. The prey has filed a formal complaint about fairness.

name: Trail's End
flavor: Know exactly where the trail ends.
discovery: "You tracked it for MILES and then — ONE shot?! You knew where it would BE before it did! The prey never stood a chance! NEVER DOES!"

discovery_method.hint: Walk the trail to its end. Then don't miss.
discovery_method.tease1: You followed the prints to a clearing and your hands were already steady — you'd known for the last mile exactly where this ended.
discovery_method.tease2: Pathfinder feet, dead-aim hands. The trail told you the ending; your aim just signed it. One shot. It was always going to be one shot.

name: Tells
flavor: Watch their face. Then read the room.
discovery: "You read FACES and ROOMS?! Nobody can bluff you AND nobody can hide from you! The poker night has been CANCELLED! Forever! READ THEM!"

discovery_method.hint: Catch the flicker. Then read what the room does with it.
discovery_method.tease1: Her smile said yes; the twitch at her eye said no. And the room — the room leaned in, hungry for whichever one won.
discovery_method.tease2: You caught the lie in his face and watched the whole table react to it before he'd finished the sentence. Face and room, both open books.

name: String Wall
flavor: Pin it up. Connect it. Step back.
discovery: "You've got STRINGS connecting EVERYTHING! It's not paranoia if the strings are RIGHT! The conspiracy board is now CANON! CONNECT IT ALL!"

discovery_method.hint: Build the board, day after day. The pattern will step forward.
discovery_method.tease1: You pinned the third theft to the board and the string practically drew itself — same hand, same hour, same excuse.
discovery_method.tease2: The board is full now, strings everywhere, and the pattern stepped out of it like it had been waiting. You just had to stop looking directly at it.

name: Airtight
flavor: Catch the lie. Then prove it.
discovery: "You CAUGHT the lie AND you can PROVE it?! That's not justice, that's a CHECKMATE! The guilty are lawyering up! PRESENT THE EVIDENCE!"

discovery_method.hint: Feel the lie first. Then build the case.
discovery_method.tease1: You knew he was lying the second he said it — the words sat wrong in the air. But knowing isn't proving, and your hands were already reaching for the board.
discovery_method.tease2: The lie, caught live. The evidence, pinned and strung. When you laid it out, there was nowhere left for the truth to hide — because you'd already found it.

name: Stones Remember
flavor: Ruins don't lie. You'd know.
discovery: "The RUINS told you what happened?! Stones don't LIE and neither do YOU, apparently! The historians are taking NOTES! ASK THE STONES!"

discovery_method.hint: Read the liar. Then read the stones.
discovery_method.tease1: You read a ruin the way you read a face — looking for where the story strained. The collapsed wall had a tell, same as any liar.
discovery_method.tease2: Ruin-reading technique in your hands, lie-sense in your gut. The old stones gave up their cache like a suspect giving up an alibi.

name: Smokehouse
flavor: Smoke the catch. Feed the village all winter.
discovery: "You smoke fish like a FACTORY and cook like a LEGEND?! The winter stores just doubled! The smoke never STOPS! KEEP SMOKING!"

discovery_method.hint: Cook the catch. Then smoke what the fire taught you.
discovery_method.tease1: The cook-fire taught you timing; the smoke taught you patience. Your hands started planning the winter stores in midsummer.
discovery_method.tease2: Camp-cook skill, fisher's hands, the village smoke technique — the racks filled and stayed filled. Nothing spoiled. Nothing was wasted.

name: Granary Heart
flavor: Save every seed. The hoard becomes a promise.
discovery: "You HOARD seeds?! Like, ON PURPOSE?! Your stash could plant a FIELD and the field would THANK you! HOARD WITH PRIDE!"

discovery_method.hint: Keep everything. Then plant the keeping.
discovery_method.tease1: Your seed jars multiplied — every harvest, a tithe to the jars. The farmer's seed-saving technique turned your hoard into a library.
discovery_method.tease2: Hoarder's instinct, farmer's skill, seed-saver's wisdom. What you kept, you planted. What you planted, remembered you.

name: Green Highway
flavor: Blaze the trail. Forage the edges.
discovery: "You blaze trails AND strip them BARE of snacks?! It's not a trail, it's a BUFFET with DIRECTIONS! The foragers are following YOU now! KEEP BLAZING!"

discovery_method.hint: Find the way. Then eat your way along it.
discovery_method.tease1: You blazed a trail the village way and your forager's eye stripped both edges as you walked — dinner, growing along the road.
discovery_method.tease2: Pathfinder's route, forager's hands, the blazers' cut. Every trail you walk feeds you twice: once going, once coming back.

name: Read the Patch
flavor: Track the plant. Know the plant. Take only the patch.
discovery: "You track plants like ANIMALS and you KNOW them by NAME?! The forest isn't hiding anything from you anymore! NOTHING! READ IT ALL!"

discovery_method.hint: Know the plant. Then follow its signs.
discovery_method.tease1: You identified a half-eaten stem and the plant-tracker's teaching surfaced — follow the browse line, find the patch. Your teacher would be proud.
discovery_method.tease2: Identification, tracking, foraging — three skills, one motion. You read the patch like a letter the forest wrote you personally.

name: Clean Kill
description: One shot. The animal never knew. Full yield, no suffering.
flavor: The perfect hunt ends before it begins.
discovery: You see it all at once — the wind, the angle, the moment. One shot.

discovery_method.hint: Line up the perfect shot — patience and knowledge, together.
discovery_method.tease1: For a heartbeat the wind, the angle, and the animal’s attention all lined up. Then it passed.
discovery_method.tease2: Twice now the perfect moment has almost happened — setup and reading, together. Something is waiting in that combination.

name: Blood Tracker
description: Wounded prey doesn't escape. You follow until it's done.
flavor: The trail doesn't lie. Neither do you.
discovery: The blood tells you where it's going. You just have to listen.

discovery_method.hint: Wound it, then stay with the trail. Don’t let it go.
discovery_method.tease1: The blood told you where it was going, and your feet already knew. For a moment the trail felt… complete.
discovery_method.tease2: Twice you’ve stayed with a blood trail to the end. The woods are teaching you a longer patience.

name: Apex Predator
description: You are the thing other things fear. Animals sense it.
flavor: The woods go quiet when you walk through. That's respect.
discovery: You don't hunt anymore. You harvest.

discovery_method.hint: Bring your mastered hunts to bear — the clean kill, the long trail — alongside new craft.
discovery_method.tease1: You moved through the woods and the woods noticed. Something in you has changed since the first clean kills.
discovery_method.tease2: The animals watch you differently now. Twice you’ve felt it — the hunted thing in you, and the hunter, agreeing.
